description: Search published Schematik build guides: complete projects with parts, wiring and firmware. Leave query empty to list featured guides first. Returns a JSON list of guides with a link and a remixUrl; pass a result's slug to get_build_guide for the full guide.

board.description: Only return guides for this board. Omit for all boards.

limit.description: How many guides to return at most. Fewer come back when fewer guides match.

query.description: What the project should do or use, matched against guide titles, descriptions and boards, e.g. 'weather station'. Leave empty to browse guides, featured ones first.

name: search_build_guides
title: Search build guides
